messages:
Marta: Quick sync 20: deciding error UX for the new Create Pool form. Two quick calls: inline (per-field) vs top summary; required marker style; and delete confirmation pattern.

Noor: Inline for obvious format errors (quota must be number, URL validation) so users get immediate feedback. For missing required fields, show after the first submit attempt to avoid noise.

Ken: UX note: if an error is inside a collapsed 'advanced' panel, expand that panel on submit and focus the first invalid control. Also surface a small top banner linking to the section.

Aisha: Accessibility: don't rely on color. if we use an asterisk include offscreen text "Required" and set aria-required="true". Link errors with aria-describedby and use role="alert" for messages added after submit.

Sam: Delete pattern: checkbox + confirm modal for simple/staging pools; typed-confirm for pools with active deployments or tagged prod. Show resource summary (deployments, machines) in the modal so users understand impact.

Lee: Timing specifics: format checks on blur (polite aria-live), required missing only after submit (assertive banner when expanding). Implement focus-to-first-invalid and announce via SR: "Form submission failed, moved to first error".

Marta: Copy draft for typed confirm modal: "Permanently delete pool "edge-prod-1"? This will remove data and active deployments. Type the pool name to confirm: `edge-prod-1`". monospace token + keep user input on mismatch.

design-bot: Summary generated:
- Inline format validation on blur.
- Required errors only after first submit; prefer visible 'Required' where space allows, fallback to asterisk + sr-only text.
- Collapsed sections auto-expand on submit fail, focus-first-invalid, top banner links to section.
- Delete flows: checkbox modal for low-risk, typed-confirm for prod/non-empty with resource summary.

Noor: +1. Also test keyboard-only flow and VoiceOver with these patterns.

Marta: I'll update the spec and open a PR with copy + a11y snippets. Thanks!"
